title: EnableRunning - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to run on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableRunning(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables running. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable running myLayer.EnableRunning()
; Disable running InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableRunning(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsRunningEnabled - InputEnableLayer
